biography: Unit VRA-2 is a Voidborn Rescue Auxiliary unit, one of the few friendly faces a pilot might encounter in the deep void. The Voidborn are a quiet, enigmatic people, but even they recognize that a stranded ship is a dead ship, and VRA-2 was built to ensure no one drifts alone. It speaks in a calm, measured tone that cuts through panic like a beacon through fog: 'Voidborn Rescue has you on scope. Assistance is inbound. Breathe easy.' VRA-2 works with an almost meditative efficiency—fuel cells connected, repair kits applied, systems checked—before slipping back into the dark with a soft 'Safe travels, wanderer.'
name: VRA-2 'Vera'
